props.name: size
props.description: The size of the color field.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text below the input.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error message to display.

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: Position of the label relative to the input.

props.name: labelAlign
props.description: Text alignment for side labels.

props.name: necessityIndicator
props.description: Whether required fields show an icon or text label.

props.name: prefix
props.description: An icon or text rendered before the input.

props.name: slot
props.description: A slot name for the component.

props.name: id
props.description: Element id for the input.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Handler called when the color changes.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ID of element that describes the field.

props.name: aria-details
props.description: ID of element that provides detailed information about the field.

props.name: aria-errormessage
props.description: ID of element that provides the error message.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the field.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of element that labels the field.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the field is disabled.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether the input should receive focus on mount.

props.name: form
props.description: Associated form owner.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name.

props.name: value
props.description: The current color value (controlled).

props.name: excludeFromTabOrder
props.description: Whether the input should be excluded from tab order.

props.name: label
props.description: A visible label for the field.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default color value (uncontrolled).

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Whether the field is read-only.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Whether the field is required.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Whether the field is invalid.

props.name: validationBehavior
props.description: Whether to use native or ARIA validation semantics.

props.name: colorSpace
props.description: The color space to use for channel mode.

props.name: channel
props.description: The color channel to edit (for single channel mode).

props.name: colorFormat
props.description: The color format for parsing/displaying.

props.name: isWheelDisabled
props.description: Whether browser wheel events should be ignored.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text.
